why: Fails the suite when scripts/ coverage drops more than a small margin below the measured baseline. Coverage facts live in data/coverage-baseline.json; the measured run is docs/coverage-2026-09-30.md. NOT wired into pytest addopts: CI installs pytest+duckdb+pyyaml only (no pytest-cov), so an addopts hook would break every plain `pytest -q tests/` run. The floor is enforced by the recorded command in docs/coverage-2026-09-30.md.
